info.title: dotnet-watch
info.description: F# hot reload through the selected SDK compiler and a standalone watch host.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Environment variables:

  DOTNET_USE_POLLING_FILE_WATCHER
  When set to '1' or 'true', dotnet-watch will poll the file system for
  changes. This is required for some file systems, such as network shares,
  Docker mounted volumes, and other virtual file systems.

  DOTNET_WATCH
  dotnet-watch sets this variable to '1' on all child processes launched.

  DOTNET_WATCH_ITERATION
  dotnet-watch sets this variable to '1' and increments by one each time
  a file is changed and the command is restarted.

  DOTNET_WATCH_SUPPRESS_EMOJIS
  When set to '1' or 'true', dotnet-watch will not show emojis in the 
  console output.

Remarks:
  The special option '--' is used to delimit the end of the options and
  the beginning of arguments that will be passed to the child dotnet process.

  For example: dotnet watch -- --verbose run

  Even though '--verbose' is an option dotnet-watch supports, the use of '--'
  indicates that '--verbose' should be treated instead as an argument for
  dotnet-run.

Examples:
  dotnet watch run
  dotnet watch test

options.name: --quiet
options.description:
Suppresses all output except warnings and errors
[default: False]

options.name: --list
options.description:
Lists all discovered files without starting the watcher.
[default: False]

options.name: --no-hot-reload
options.description:
Suppress hot reload for supported apps.
[default: False]

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description:
Runs dotnet-watch in non-interactive mode. This option is only supported when running with Hot Reload enabled.
Use this option to prevent console input from being captured.
[default: False]

options.name: --framework
options.description: The target framework to build for. The target framework must also be specified in the project file.

options.name: --device
options.description: The device identifier to run on (e.g. emulator, simulator, or physical device).

options.name: --project
options.description: Defines the path of the project file to run. Use path to the project file, or path to the directory containing the project file. If not specified, it defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --file
options.description: The path to the file-based app to run (can be also passed as the first argument if there is no project in the current directory).

options.name: --launch-profile
options.description: The name of the launch profile (if any) to use when launching the application.

options.name: --no-launch-profile
options.description: Do not attempt to use launchSettings.json or [app].run.json to configure the application. [default: False]
